request: Pull FEMA Disaster Declaration Summaries from OpenFEMA OData v2 since 2022-01-01, treat each declaration as a public-safety incident case, enrich with days_since_declaration, days_open (declarationDate to disasterCloseoutDate), incidentType-by-state hot-spot trend analysis, and publish to 'Prep Agent / 05 - FEMA Disaster Cases' on Tableau Server for emergency-management analysts.

sources.name: FEMA Disaster Declarations
sources.description: OpenFEMA Disaster Declarations Summaries v2. Each row = one disaster declaration (county-level granularity for some entities). Filtered to declarationDate > 2022-01-01 (~7K rows). Public, keyless. OData v2 pagination: $top (page size) + $skip (offset).

args.name: Disaster Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from declarationDate (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week, is_weekend). Pure pass-through of FEMA disaster declaration records.
args.stats_description: Long-form FEMA disaster statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over state, incidentType, declarationType). Includes monthly_count, 90-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify states with surging disaster declarations or anomalous incident-type concentrations.

outputs.name: FEMA Disaster Detail
outputs.description: Row-level FEMA disaster declarations (one row per declaration since 2022-01-01) including femaDeclarationString, disasterNumber, state, declarationType (DR/FM/EM), declarationDate, fyDeclared, incidentType (Hurricane, Wildfire, Severe Storm, etc.), declarationTitle, designatedArea (county-level when applicable), days_since_declaration, days_open, plus boolean flags for IA/IH/PA/HM program declared and calendar features. Source: OpenFEMA v2. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: FEMA Disaster Stats
outputs.description: Long-form FEMA disaster statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over state, incidentType, declarationType). Includes 90-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Source: OpenFEMA v2.
